messages.subject: NGINX Proxy for shiny
parts:
Hi,

I know this feature is planed for Shiny server release, but I wonder why current shiny version displays a grey filter on the page ... (like when a misfunction is found by shiny)

my nginx conf:

http {

        server {
                listen 80;
 ...

                location /shiny/ {
                        rewrite ^/shiny/(.*)$ /$1 break;
                        proxy_pass http://localhost:8100;
                        proxy_redirect http://localhost:8100/ $scheme://$host/shiny/;
                }
 ...


Best regards,

Yann
